Notes and reminders help you pick things up again.
en.presenceNote: Move it. Resize it. Or hide it for a while.
faqs: How do I get started?
Download the app for your computer, connect a model service, and give your companion a name. The setup guide walks you through your first conversation.
Which computers can run it?

macOS on Apple Silicon, or Windows 10 22H2 x64 and later with Microsoft Edge WebView2. Windows packages are not Authenticode signed, so SmartScreen or organization policies may warn or block them. Linux desktop is not supported.
Do I need a model account?

Yes, connect a supported model service or your local Codex installation. Caelis is included in the desktop packages. The app download does not include a paid model subscription; available models and costs depend on your service.
Are my chats entirely offline?

Bot keeps its conversation history and Notebook on your computer. A connected model service or tool may receive the context needed for your request. Local storage does not make online model calls offline.
Can it see and do anything on my computer?

You choose what to share and which tools to enable. Screen questions require an image-capable model; desktop actions may need system permissions and foreground access. Account logins and decisions that need your approval remain with you.
Can I hide the character?
Yes. Move, resize or hide it to suit your day. Closing chat or hiding the character keeps Bot running. Quitting the app pauses scheduled reminders until it is running again.

faqs: 怎样开始使用？
下载适合电脑的版本，连接模型服务，再给伙伴取个名字。使用指南会带你完成第一次对话。
支持哪些电脑？
支持 Apple Silicon Mac，以及 Windows 10 22H2 x64 或更高版本；Windows 需安装 Microsoft Edge WebView2。Windows 安装包未做 Authenticode 签名，SmartScreen 或组织策略可能提示或拦截。暂不支持 Linux 桌面。
需要模型账号吗？
需要连接受支持的模型服务，或你本机安装的 Codex。桌面安装包已包含 Caelis，但不包含付费模型订阅；可用模型及费用由你选择的服务决定。
对话完全离线吗？
Bot 将对话历史与 Notebook 笔记保存在你的电脑。连接的模型服务或工具可能接收完成请求所需的上下文。本地存储不代表在线模型调用变成了离线处理。
它能随意查看和操作电脑吗？
由你决定分享哪些内容、启用哪些工具。屏幕提问需要支持图片的模型，桌面操作可能需要系统权限和前台访问。账号登录以及需要你审批的决定仍由你完成。
可以隐藏角色吗？
可以。按自己的习惯移动、缩放或隐藏。关闭聊天窗口、隐藏角色不会退出 Bot；退出应用后，定时提醒会暂停，直到再次运行。
